content: Fǝrra nuneefa mǝrna chimadghǝn
Tǝrangna Yeeso tenggǝnsǝ, na fa ƙǝnaya nǝn ɓanda ɓa tǝ fǝryindan kanda a irangnda ahu panjakwad Ƙǝn Faara hai na manggǝn.
Na nuneefa nǝn mǝrna chimadghǝn ƙǝm tǝ yamirha fǝr yighǝn nǝn anini sǝri.
Ndagha Yeeso, “Kǝkafek niya pǝranggǝn kun, fǝrrǝɗi ki nuɗi tǝ yamidɗiya kalɗǝ yi fingya na heu.
Nafini na heu ya fǝrghanda ahu hangnda ˈya na nanda tǝghǝn ha, amma ndǝghǝn nggi ahu yamidghǝn fǝrɗǝ ˈya na a harghǝn heu.”
Tsahad Yeeso ha aten ˈya na a katǝrarha hai a mbee
Tǝrgha fingya fatsahayighǝn katǝrang ngganda tsǝ laɓara hai aten tǝn ƙǝn hwan Faarɗi na manggǝn tǝ ferya na nggǝngga, sakhɗang nanda sǝ tǝ ǝn fǝrya a Faara. Amma ndagha Yeeso,
“Kǝla nanun feryini ya, yoo! Na farghǝn ɓayi mbuwanda malang feera aten shadghǝn. Ko yanggini ahur ndan nanda a changgǝlang kanda hai.”
Tsakh mee nda, “Mala, akwan na ǝnggini a katǝrarha hai ya? Tǝ ƙǝm mani ǝn sakhrha na a sǝnansǝ nduwus ɓenɗaɓa ya?”
Ndǝghǝn, “Kwarama kanda, amana nda sakhɗang kun. Ƙǝsǝr fiya hangga na a ɓarhaɓa ahu thlǝmna na nda a ndaarha, ‘Nggini Ƙǝrǝsti,’ tǝ ndaarha ƙǝm ‘nduwus ɓenɗaɓa.’ Ma mbuɗun samandan wa.
A tǝrǝmɗun wa, a sǝkɗun laɓar yangya tǝ kakyathlanga. Kǝkafekni a katǝragha ǝnggina hai ya ˈwan, amma mii ngwaladghǝn ɓalghǝn kula ɓarha ɓa.”
Tǝrgha ndanggǝn kanda, “Tur nǝn thleng tur fa, kutǝryirha ƙǝm nǝn thleng kutǝryirha fa.
Na ƙǝshiirha a rǝbrha fa kaan, tǝ mirha, tǝ patal a mbǝya ɗǝɗamǝn. Na ǝntǝrǝmgya a naarha sǝ tǝ ƙǝm nun na ǝnsakrha yi wulteena hangga a fǝrakh amshi.

“Amma kapa na ǝnggini katǝrarha hai ya, nanda a ƙǝsang kun, sǝsangganda kun. Nanda a ɗǝrha tǝ kun ahu ƙǝngya hwan Faara ɗǝ, tǝ ƙǝm muwangganda kun ahu porsǝna ɗǝ. Nanda a ɗǝrha tǝ kun a mbed kutǝrya ɗǝ tǝ ngwamnaya ka thlǝmna.
Ənɗaniya na fǝrang kwamana kun pǝr ƙǝkafek nun atenna.
Amma tsaunǝn kee, ˈwama teena nggon fa ahur nun ma ɓillaɗun tǝ kwaman thlang fannun sǝ a mbed fa ngwa kumaya wa.
Ƙǝsǝr niya fǝrang pathla kun tǝ sǝnda, ko tal ahur fa tsangginun mba nda mbang kyakhrang laɓarnun hai, nduwa ngaalangganda kun wa.
Ko fa nggǝt yinun, tǝ wanmangginun, tǝ hurfayinun, tǝ pashiyi nun na nda a fǝr kun. Na nda a ɓǝlang nda fingya ƙǝm ahur nun.
Fiya na heu nanda a karkun ƙǝsǝr ka nggi.
Amma ko tal ahu was tennun mbusǝ na a sahatta wa.
A ƙǝrǝsɗun, nun a hǝrǝkrha.”
Pǝr Yeeso kwamanɗi na Urshelima a fǝla hai
“Anaɗun sodjaya tǝrang nda hurshe Urshelima teena, a sǝnunsǝ takh nda a chang hai.
Tǝrgha fingya na ahu Yahudiya, ɗaa nda wumngya sǝ. Fingya ƙǝm na a wupǝri kya nda sǝ, fingya ƙǝm, na hu talya a ɗǝnda wupǝri ɗǝ wa.
Ƙǝsǝr sayidɗiya ɓen sǝsaarha ni, tǝ lǝghǝtta ǝngya heu chireethleng nanda hai.
Kawama nishya na ahur, tǝ fingya na wanggindan a iirha! A farɗiya, na sǝsaarha a kyarha hu chehwedɗa hai tǝ sǝbrha hur Faara aten nafini ya.
Nanda a ɓǝlang fingya tǝ thlaukh ƙǝlara, ƙǝsangganda fingya tsawa nda porsǝngya hu chehweeya ɗǝ pak. Fingya mbuwa Yahudaya, nanda thlǝ Urshelima sǝssangganda ƙǝl ma lǝghǝd ɓen ndan.
Wutta Wan Niifa ɓa
“Nun a na ǝn tǝrǝmngya a fad yanfaara, ndǝre tǝ wufǝlngarya. A hu ƙǝshiirha ƙǝm, na fiya a peela hai ka hǝreenga ƙǝsǝr ka hufrha tǝ yanda wuri aama.
Nǝn a shiwid fiya teena ka tǝrǝmnda, na ƙǝfayindan a haara ka ǝngya na a ɓarha hu ƙǝshiirha ɓa, ƙǝsǝr ǝngya na mǝmanggǝn a fǝrakh amshi nanda a tsǝ ˈya fa.
A farɗi, nanda a na Wan Niifa ɓayi ahu hashmbe tǝ sǝsǝmnda tǝ mamnggirha kaan.
Ana ǝnggini a katǝrarha hai ya, thlema sǝ tǝranggun tennun talara sǝ, ƙǝsǝr far hǝrǝƙrǝnun nduwusɗa ɓa.”
Tsaharhaha aten ɗǝf shiɓarha
Thlǝghang karapu ɗa nǝn kanda sǝ ya, “Kǝlaman shiɓarha tǝ ɗǝfya na heu.
A hǝrǝmna nda katǝrang tsǝtsǝtta hai, kun tǝ altennun sǝnɗunsǝ nduwus fegrha ɓa.
Nǝghǝn kee ƙǝm, anaɗun ǝnggini a katǝrarha hai ya, sǝnɗunsǝ Kutǝryid Faara nduwus ɗa ɓa.
“Niya pǝrang ƙǝkafek kun, nafiya ƙǝshiid weeriya mba nda a mǝra wa, ƙǝl katǝrana ǝnggina hai ya ˈwan.
Nda talara tǝ hweeɗe nanda a ngwalarha, amma laɓarna mbǝ tam ngwalarha wa.
Yiyi thlǝmarha aten tsaurha nggu-ngwa fa
“Kwarama, amana hur nun mǝra tǝ mbǝna farha fa, tǝ sa ǝngya na tǝrang kun in, tǝ ɓillad tsawud ƙǝshiirha. A mbǝ kewa, ɓana farɗi wal kun kula sǝndǝnun sǝ ƙǝla takthleera.
Ƙǝsǝr nǝn ɓarha ten fiya ɓa heu na a tsaurhahu ƙǝshiirha.
Tsawama nggu-ngwa fa, ƙǝtsar. Hwan Faara nun tǝ nun wal hǝrǝkrha aten ǝnggini na ɓa katǝrarha hai, amana shilee ɓa ƙǝsang kun isha a mbed Wan Niifa.”
Ka fad par fara fa, na Yeeso tsaharhaha hu Wuri Faara. Ka fad figrha fa ƙǝm nǝn kyarha sǝ, ɗǝgha mǝnda a wumnda nanda aarha Wumnda ɗǝfya Dzaitun.
A tsar ƙǝrǝt, na fiya ɗǝrha hu Ƙǝn Faara ɗǝ na manggǝn ka a sǝk laɓarghǝn nda.
